title: Deeper/broader DXF VIEWPORT and peer-contract refresh
scope: Independent DXF/DWG peer scope and qualification boundary
Fail-closed adapter behavior for unclosed VIEWPORT references

sources.finding: 332 background, 333 shade plot, and 361 sun are optional ID/handle fields; the page does not state a universal target class/root contract; shade mode 170 is documented as 0-3; visual style 348 is a separate field.
Separately exposes background, shade-plot, visual-style, sun, clipping, UCS, and frozen-layer properties; structural API presence does not establish graph closure or native rendering.
Viewport rendering depends on clipping, per-viewport layer state, and renderer capabilities; not equivalent to parser retention.
Useful separate decoder/converter route, but project docs disclose advanced R2010+ skipped objects and later DWG writer limitations.
Public docs cover reader/writer presence but not per-family semantic qualification.
Explicitly excludes VIEWPORT from stated R10-R2014 entity support; not a VIEWPORT comparator.

local_audit.reason: The adapter has no retained/rooted DRW_Background or DRW_Sun collections, and VIEWPORT code 333 has no mode-specific target closure. Low-level handle remapping alone does not close the object graph.

implementation.change: Reject nonzero VIEWPORT 332, 333, and 361 in adapter preflight until class/owner/mode-specific target closure is implemented.
implementation.tests: Generated negative controls assert rejection before output publication for each field.
